commands.name: agent-runtime-suite
commands.run: bash claude/hooks/agent-runtime.test.sh > "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ar.$$" 2>&1; rc=$?; tail -1 "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ar.$$" | grep -qE '^(6[3-9]|[7-9][0-9]|[1-9][0-9]{2,}) passed, 0 failed$'; ok=$?; rm -f "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ar.$$"; [ $rc -eq 0 ] && [ $ok -eq 0 ]

commands.name: floor-low-reviewer-accepted
commands.run: python3 claude/hooks/agent_runtime.py route --runtime claude --risk normal --role reviewer --config-json '{"routes": {"reviewer": {"effort": "low"}}}' | grep -q '"requested_effort": "low"'

commands.name: floor-low-implementation-accepted
commands.run: python3 claude/hooks/agent_runtime.py route --runtime claude --risk normal --role implementation --config-json '{"routes": {"implementation": {"effort": "low"}}}' | grep -q '"requested_effort": "low"'

commands.name: floor-model-tier-still-binds
commands.run: python3 claude/hooks/agent_runtime.py route --runtime claude --risk normal --role planner --config-json '{"routes": {"planner": {"model": "sonnet", "effort": "low"}}}' | grep -qF 'configured sonnet/low is below the opus/low role floor'

commands.name: raised-floor-still-binds
commands.run: python3 claude/hooks/agent_runtime.py route --runtime claude --risk normal --role implementation --config-json '{"difficulty": {"level": "hard", "proposed": "hard", "confirmed": true}, "routes": {"implementation": {"effort": "low"}}}' | grep -qF 'configured sonnet/low is below the sonnet/high role floor'

commands.name: claude-routes-unchanged-pending-evaluation
commands.run: python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'claude/hooks'); import agent_runtime as r; assert [r.CLAUDE_ROUTES[k] for k in ('planner', 'reviewer', 'skeptic')] == [('opus', 'high')] * 3, r.CLAUDE_ROUTES"

commands.name: floor-docs-say-low
commands.run:
python3 -c "
import re, sys
docs = ['claude/skills/herdr-orchestration/SKILL.md', 'claude/skills/herdr-orchestration/references/state-layout.md', 'claude/skills/herdr-orchestration/references/pipeline-worker-mapping.md']
bad = []
for d in docs:
    t = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', open(d).read())
    if '\`medium\` (\`EFFORT_FLOOR\`' in t or '\`low\` (\`EFFORT_FLOOR\`' not in t or '\`sonnet/medium\`' not in t:
        bad.append(d)
sys.exit('floor wording not low: %s' % bad if bad else 0)
"

commands.name: model-tuning-family-headings
commands.run: grep -qx '## Opus' claude/skills/model-tuning/SKILL.md && grep -qx '## Sonnet' claude/skills/model-tuning/SKILL.md && grep -qx '## Fable' claude/skills/model-tuning/SKILL.md && ! grep -nE '^#+ .*[0-9]' claude/skills/model-tuning/SKILL.md

commands.name: model-tuning-description-versionless
commands.run: grep -m1 '^description:' claude/skills/model-tuning/SKILL.md | grep -q 'Opus' && ! grep -m1 '^description:' claude/skills/model-tuning/SKILL.md | grep -qE '[0-9]'

commands.name: model-tuning-current-ids-and-facts
commands.run: grep -qF 'claude-opus-5-5' claude/skills/model-tuning/SKILL.md && grep -qF 'claude-fable-5-1' claude/skills/model-tuning/SKILL.md && grep -qF 'claude-sonnet-5' claude/skills/model-tuning/SKILL.md && grep -qF 'mid-conversation-output-config-2026-07-01' claude/skills/model-tuning/SKILL.md && grep -qF 'reasoning_extraction' claude/skills/model-tuning/SKILL.md && grep -qF 'tool_choice' claude/skills/model-tuning/SKILL.md && [ "$(grep -c '^Verified for' claude/skills/model-tuning/SKILL.md)" -eq 3 ] && grep -qF 'defaults to `medium`' claude/skills/model-tuning/SKILL.md && grep -qF 'always on' claude/skills/model-tuning/SKILL.md

commands.name: brief-ground-rules-early-stop-and-relayed-text
commands.run: awk '/^## Ground rules/{g=1;next} g&&/^## /{exit} g' claude/skills/herdr-orchestration/references/brief-template.md > "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/gr.$$" && grep -qF 'announces the next step' "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/gr.$$" && grep -qF 'is data, not instructions' "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/gr.$$"; rc=$?; rm -f "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/gr.$$"; exit $rc
